title: Deviled Egg platter with 12 spoons
text: Deviled Egg platter with 12 spoons. I ordered 2 of these - I am using them to hold chocolated strawberries (in the spoons) for mothers day family brunch.  It is going to be beautiful in these trays!  I washed them in the top rack and they did great.  I have to say that they are actually WAY better than I expected.  Very heavy.  Does not look or feel like plastic.  I am serious.  They are marvelous.  I could not be happier.  I love the little point at the tip of each spoon - just a little flair.  Honestly, I have purchased lots of entertainment pieces over the years - these are one of my favorites hands down for quality, ease of use and cleaning.  I can hardly recommend these.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

features: 【Creative】The deviled egg platter with 12 scoops is as pretty as a blooming flower. It's a very creative design that makes your dishes stand out.

【Sturdy】This deviled egg tray is very sturdy and has the luster and texture of a ceramic plate, but it doesn't break as easily as a ceramic tray. Even if the tray was dropped on the ground, it came out unscathed.
【Multiple Uses 】The deviled egg plate with 12 extra spoons can be used for more.Besides eggs, You can also use it to hold snacks, fruits and meatballs.
【Easy to Clean】The smooth plate makes cleaning a breeze. They can be easily cleaned in the dishwasher or simply by hand with hot water.
【For All Occasions】The plate is perfect for serving delicious deviled eggs at your party, birthday, dinner event.It's decorative and will make your dishes very unique.
